lines.say: Forty of his regulars quit in one winter. The heater was already fixed.
A barber in a town of three hundred and eleven. His heater died in January, so he shut six days.
Six days. By day three, his regulars were at a gas station guy's cold garage.
He fixed it on day seven, told nobody, and sat there. Five weeks. Nobody came in.
caps: He fixed it on day seven,
told no one, and sat there.

lines.say: Forty clients, all sure his shop was still shut. Still freezing. Damn.
Then a kid asked in March why the sign still said closed. He'd never flipped it.
caps: A kid asked in March why

lines.say: Five weeks. Forty clients. One fucking sign.
Your clients don't know your chair is open either. Nobody told them they were still welcome.
